2607.20937.title: Clustered Edge Intelligence: Beyond Just Convergence of Edge Computing and AI
2607.20937.paper_summary: We are moving from an information age to the age of intelligence. A decade, or possibly less than that, data will not be the gold anymore rather the derived intelligence out of the data and the information we posses from the edge of the network. Existing Edge Intelligence research focuses mainly on two directions: using AI for edge resource management and deploying lightweight AI models on edge devices. However, existing edge computing research lacks an intelligence-centric framework in which derived intelligence is treated as a first-class, independently manageable entity that can be described, discovered, observed, shared, reused, and dynamically clustered across heterogeneous edge devices and applications. To address these research gaps, we introduced Clustered Edge Intelligence, a visionary intelligence-centric approach. The aim of CEI is to make intelligence a shareable and reusable first-class entity that can be independently represented, discovered, observed, exchanged, and managed across the distributed edge-cloud continuum. We present a three layer CEI architecture and examine enabling technologies and research dimensions, including intelligence inventories, semantic knowledge representation, communication, discoverability, observability, lifecycle automation, clustering mechanisms, marketplaces, interoperability, and standardization.
2607.20937.paper_summary_zh: 我們正從資訊時代轉向智慧時代。十年內，或許更短的時間內，數據將不再是黃金，而是從我們擁有的數據和網絡邊緣信息中衍生出的智慧。現有的邊緣智慧研究主要集中在兩個方向：使用人工智慧進行邊緣資源管理和在邊緣設備上部署輕量級人工智慧模型。然而，現有的邊緣計算研究缺乏一個以智慧為中心的框架，在這個框架中，衍生的智慧被視為一個一級的、可獨立管理的實體，可以在異構邊緣設備和應用之間進行描述、發現、觀察、共享、重用和動態聚類。為了填補這些研究空白，我們提出了集群邊緣智慧（Clustered Edge Intelligence），這是一種具有前瞻性的以智慧為中心的方法。CEI的目標是使智慧成為一個可共享和重用的一級實體，可以在分佈式邊緣雲連續體中獨立表示、發現、觀察、交換和管理。我們提出了一個三層CEI架構，並檢視促成技術和研究維度，包括智慧庫、語義知識表示、通信、可發現性、可觀察性、生命周期自動化、聚類機制、市場、互操作性和標準化。
